title: Online Retail II
creator: Daqing Chen
citation: Chen, D. (2012). Online Retail II [Dataset]. UCI Machine Learning Repository. https://doi.org/10.24432/C5CG6D.
transformations: ZIP extraction without editing workbook bytes
Read OOXML numeric lexemes as strings, never through binary float
Derive exact GBP minor units with existing Money kernel; retain invalid/incompatible rows
Retain all source lines, duplicate content, sheet names and physical row numbers
Aggregate separately for offline evaluation; no financial documents or settlement labels generated

normalization_decision.question: How should Excel near-penny numeric representations be normalized for a future invoice importer?
normalization_decision.current_behavior: Preserve raw lexeme and quarantine any non-exact-penny price. Diagnostic threshold never changes acceptance.
